title: Bidwell House Museum

services.name: Event Rentals
services.desc: Located on 194 acres of verdant forests and gardens in Monterey, the Bidwell House Museum could be the perfect spot for your outdoor wedding or celebration. The Museum tells the story of life in the 18th century Berkshires and your guests will feel like they are driving back in time as they make their way down Art School Road, a dirt lane lined with trees. The property has large open fields and lush landscapes with room for a large tent and parking for 100 cars. In summer when the gardens are in their glory you will find a myriad of locations for memorable photos.
